map.locality_method: Discovery extents route published regional data and prioritize nearby notices. They are not legal boundaries or evidence of fish presence. Protected areas use the authoritative polygon screen. Closed seasons remain selectable for future planning.

unavailable_targets.dungeness: Dungeness is not a promoted Southern California target. Crab traps and snares are prohibited south of Point Arguello; this is not a blanket prohibition on every method of crab collection. See official CDFW invertebrate rules.
unavailable_targets.salmon: Salmon is not in this region’s researched target list. That is not a closed-season determination; check the official CDFW salmon rules.

bathymetry.reason: Eleven original NOAA BAG footprints near Anacapa and eastern Santa Cruz have native 1–4 m MLLW depth, product uncertainty and a conservative <=200 ft screen. Other island terrain views remain context; complete coastal coverage is not claimed.

substrate.reason: Actual NOAA historical hard/soft island footprints clipped to native source-depth masks and closures, plus CDFW historical constructed reefs. Variable source accuracy; not a boulder inventory.

groundtruth.reason: Regional data not imported. No neighboring region’s evidence is reused.

kelp.reason: Actual CDFW canopy and subsurface detections from September 2016, including Catalina. Historical context only; no live kelp claim.

protected-areas.reason: Complete regional CDFW MPA snapshot plus NOAA’s eight Groundfish Exclusion Areas. Context areas also excluded from closures.

regulations.reason: Southern jurisdiction: seasonal 50-fathom legal line, species sublimits and daily official-source checks.

dynamic-closures.reason: CDFW in-season, health and gear watches plus NOAA exclusion areas. Navy/security access around islands requires direct local clearance.

wind-forecast.reason: NOAA GFS and ECMWF IFS at regional sea-grid samples.

wave-forecast.reason: NOAA GFS Wave and ECMWF WAM at regional sea-grid samples.

wave-observations.reason: Multiple local NDBC/CDIP references from San Diego through Santa Barbara; not continuous nearshore observations.

weather-observations.reason: Source discovery and regional evidence gaps remain visible; this is not a complete measurement of the region.

tides.reason: San Diego, Los Angeles and Santa Barbara NOAA reference stations; selection follows forecast area.

surface-currents.reason: Operational HFR observations and WCOFS surface forecasts; local reception holes remain blank and horizon is at most 72 hours.

subsurface-ocean.reason: Promising primary sources identified; regional records, precision and rights still need review.

sea-temperature.reason: Native 0.01-degree MUR analysis with dated source errors and masks; NOAA 0.04-degree WCOFS surface-temperature forecasts at actual populated times through at most 72 hours. Neither establishes fish-depth temperature or catch probability.

chlorophyll.reason: Source discovery and regional evidence gaps remain visible; this is not a complete measurement of the region.

species-occurrence.reason: Regional data not imported. No neighboring region’s evidence is reused.

catch-effort.reason: Regional data not imported. No neighboring region’s evidence is reused.

charter-identity.reason: Local operator identity and MMSI review pending.

ais-history.reason: No verified local vessel histories or dwell clusters imported.

harbor-access.reason: Regional reference harbor only. Actual departure harbor, route and entrance clearance remain trip-specific.

wind-ensemble.reason: Reviewed live adapter with source/member metadata and grid distances; per-run availability is checked separately.

wave-ensemble.reason: Reviewed live adapter with source/member metadata and grid distances; per-run availability is checked separately.

forecast-verification.reason: New prospective archive begins with deployment; no backfilled skill or calibrated catch probability.

coverage_note: Eleven source-qualified reef patches near Anacapa and eastern Santa Cruz supplement historical habitat context. Unmapped areas and unverified fish presence remain unknown.
landing_note: No Southern California catch-position dataset has been imported; landing totals are not fishing coordinates.
